steps.hardClue: Lure the special enemy into destroying a marked wall to reveal a hidden chamber.
steps.clue: Use the Warden to break open the Ritual Chamber.

steps.hardClue: Activate the chair, place the red stone in the laboratory, then activate the book.
steps.clue: Activate the electric chair, place the red stone in Richtofen’s Lab, then activate the Kronorium.

steps.hardClue: Track the hidden bird and blast it over three rounds.
steps.clue: Track the Spectral Bird and Spirit Blast it over three rounds.

steps.hardClue: Use a temporary power-up and a throwable weapon to recover the stolen book.
steps.clue: Use Zombie Blood and the Hell’s Retriever to recover the Kronorium from the final bird.

steps.hardClue: Read the book’s codes and use them to locate five hidden portals.
steps.clue: Read the Kronorium codes and use the lighthouse to locate the five challenge portals.

steps.hardClue: Complete the five trials and collect their red orbs.
steps.clue: Complete the five lighthouse trials and collect their red orbs.

steps.hardClue: Place the five stones in Richtofen’s map, then confront the Warden in the Ritual Chamber.
steps.clue: Place the five red orbs in Richtofen’s map, then return to the Warden’s corpse in the Ritual Chamber.

steps.hardClue: Escape, follow the bird and recover the final red orb.
steps.clue: Escape the prison cells, follow the Spectral Bird and recover the Warden’s final red orb.

steps.hardClue: Place the final orb in the map, then open the hidden entrance in the laboratory.
steps.clue: Place the final red orb in Richtofen’s map, then open the entrance to the Dark Mechanism.

steps.hardClue: Destroy the boss’s spectral orbs and charge the central machine.
steps.clue: Destroy the Warden’s spectral orbs, charge the Dark Mechanism and sacrifice Richtofen.
